fair_value_reason: Citation fix 2026-10-06. Recurring NTM EPS at Oct-2027 from the stated inputs (product $690M/$890M at 51%/54% GM, legacy royalty ~$60M/yr, VPD ~$70M/$85M, opex ~$215M/$255M, 21% tax, 48.5M diluted shares; all estimates, not reported): 2027 ($351.9M + $60M + $70M - $215M) x 0.79 / 48.5M = $4.35; 2028 ($480.6M + $60M + $85M - $255M) x 0.79 / 48.5M = $6.04; NTM 0.25 x 4.35 + 0.75 x 6.04 = $5.61, excluding interest income. 28x (26.0x CY2027 power-peer median recomputed from finviz 2026-10-05 closes, +~8%) = $157.2. Plus net cash $9.20/share = ($453.582M cash - $1.767M - $5.841M lease liabilities, Q2-26 10-Q; no borrowings) / 48.5M. Total $166.4 -> $166. Interest income is left out of EPS so the cash is not counted twice. Excluded: the $60M licence (Q2-26 call, CFO: '$5 million in Q3 and $10 million per quarter for the following four quarters', total $60M; Motley Fool transcript 2026-07-21), any Q3 back-royalty, the 2025 $45M settlement and 2026 tax benefits. The round-2 $180 did not follow from its own inputs (it needed ~$30M/yr of unlisted other income); the interim $167 used a rounded ~$10/share net cash.

thesis_triggers.event: Below ~$140 (~23x a ~$5.61 recurring NTM EPS (ex-interest) after ~$9.2/share cash at the horizon, ~24% under the $184 pre-licence close of 2026-09-16, and below the Aug-2026 closing range of $187.68-$253.50, Twelve Data), the market would be pricing a failed licensing leg. That means the VPD royalty proving mostly back-payment (run-rate <$10M/qtr), the late-2027 renewals of the two-year licences lapsing or repricing down, or an adverse 337-TA-1484 outcome (USITC target date 2027-09-20). It could also mean the product backlog ($379.7M) rolling over. Agents ranged $125-155 (mean $141).

supervisor_summary: VICR at $305.61 trades at 48x CY2027 consensus against a verified 26x power-peer median. On recurring earnings (excluding the fixed $60M licence, which ends Q3-27, and any Q3 back-royalty) fair value is ~$166 (corrected 2026-10-06 from $180: the stated inputs give $5.61 recurring NTM EPS ex-interest, x 28 + $9.20 net cash). The agents converged to fair values of $157-175 and ladder medians of $192-218 (after the 2026-10-06 citation fix and citation gate), but mostly by anchoring on my round-1 inputs, not through independent evidence. I re-verified every fact they copied (licence schedule, >30% Q3 guide, 46.1M basic / 47.7M diluted shares, $453.6M cash and no debt) and leave the ladder near their mean (median ~$205, P>=spot 0.24 after the fair-value shift). The ~Oct-20 Q3 report, which gives the first VPD run-rate disclosure, is the key event. Aerospace & defense is ~12% of revenue (defense ~8.5%): flag, not exclude.
key_drivers: Recurring vs back-royalty split of the VPD licence signed 2026-09-16 (>= ~$29M in Q3-26); first disclosure at the ~Oct-20 Q3 report.

Fixed $60M licence: revenue $15M Q2-26, $5M Q3-26, $10M/qtr Q4-26 to Q3-27, then zero unless the two-year licence is renewed in late 2027 (CFO, Q2 call); renewal timing coincides with the 337-TA-1484 target date of 2027-09-20 (USITC IDS record, re-checked 2026-10-06; final initial determination due 2027-05-20).
Product growth within Fab-1 capacity: backlog $379.7M, product GM 46.7% in Q2-26; Fab-2 is not before late 2027/2028.
Multiple: 48.1x CY2027 consensus EPS vs a 26.0x verified power-peer median (+85%); fair value uses ~28x on recurring EPS.

Customer concentration: per the 10-K, the majority of Advanced Products revenue comes from one or a limited number of customers, concentrated in data-center/hyperscaler. Advanced Products incl. royalties were 61.0% of 2025 revenue (product-only ~47%).
